summary: Evaxion A/S filed a Form 6-K on July 17, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing plans to present three-year clinical efficacy data for its personalized cancer vaccine EVX-01 at the ESMO Congress 2026. The press release details that the data derive from a one-year extension of a phase 2 trial in advanced melanoma, with patients receiving EVX-01 as stand-alone therapy in the third year. No special-situation transaction is involved; the filing is a routine event report on clinical trial progress. There are no deal terms, board actions, or structural changes. This is a standard current report for foreign private issuers, not a special situation.
